english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that makes someone lose face or feel humiliated.
Use this colloquially when something disgraceful is humiliating or makes someone lose face.
Use this when the shameful thing specifically makes someone lose face or look bad.
Use this when the emphasis is on losing face or dignity, especially in front of other people.

examples.english: Being scolded in front of so many people is really degrading.
examples.traditional: 喺咁多人面前畀人鬧，真係好丟架。
examples.jyutping: hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 bei2 jan4 naau6 zan1 hai6 hou2 diu1 gaa2

examples.english: Falling over like that on stage was really ignominious.
Being yelled at until he cried in front of the whole company was really shameful.
examples.traditional: 佢喺成間公司嘅人面前畀人鬧到喊，真係好丟架。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 seng4 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jan4 min6 cin4 bei2 jan4 naau6 dou3 haam3 zan1 hai6 hou2 diu1 gaa2

examples.english: Being told off by the teacher in front of the whole class was really humiliating.
examples.traditional: 喺全班同學面前畀老師鬧，真係好丟架。
examples.jyutping: hai2 cyun4 baan1 tung4 hok6 min6 cin4 bei2 lou5 si1 naau6 zan1 hai6 hou2 diu1 gaa2
